principle: ARIF speaks missions. The federation silently orchestrates tools. One verdict returns.
anti_principle: Never show ARIF a tool list. Never ask ARIF which organ to use.

investigate.label: Investigate — Gather and test reality
investigate.description: Read-only evidence collection across organs. No mutation. Returns structured observations with uncertainty bounds.
investigate.output: Structured evidence bundle with epistemic tags and confidence

interpret.label: Interpret — Build competing explanations
human_trigger_examples: Give me competing explanations for Y
interpret.description: Multi-hypothesis reasoning. GEOX interprets earth evidence. WEALTH interprets capital signals. WELL interprets human state. arifOS synthesizes with uncertainty.
interpret.output: Ranked hypotheses with evidence support, contradictions surfaced, uncertainty explicit

decide.label: Decide — Compare consequences and uncertainty
human_trigger_examples: What happens if we choose Y?
Compare option A and option B
decide.description: Constitutional decision support. Every path through consequence modeling, reversibility test, and floor check. Returns recommendation with kill criteria.
decide.output: Single recommendation with: kill criteria, confidence, reversibility, what would change the decision
decide.autonomy: ASK — irreversible decisions always require sovereign approval

build.label: Build — Prepare and execute approved changes
human_trigger_examples: Make the change we agreed on
build.description: Governed execution. arifOS validates authority → A-FORGE plans + simulates → arifOS seals → A-FORGE executes → VAULT999 records. Never self-authorizing.
build.output: Execution receipt with rollback path, before/after hashes, and immutable seal
build.autonomy: ASK — mutation always requires sovereign seal

monitor.label: Monitor — Detect change, degradation, or danger
human_trigger_examples: Watch X and tell me if it changes
Alert me if Y exceeds threshold
monitor.description: Continuous observation loop. Compares current state against baseline. Surfaces deltas, degradation, and anomalies. Silent when healthy.
monitor.output: Delta report: what changed, what degraded, what needs attention. Silent when all healthy.

remember.label: Remember — Retrieve and preserve governed knowledge
human_trigger_examples: What did we decide about X?
Show me the evidence for Y
remember.description: L1-L6 memory traversal. Semantic recall across Redis, Qdrant, Supabase, Graphiti, and VAULT999. Sealed records are immutable proof.
remember.output: Retrieved knowledge with provenance chain and seal verification
remember.autonomy: AUTO_DO for recall; ASK for seal

router_rules.intent_classification: arifOS classifies the human statement into the closest mission. If ambiguous, asks ONE clarifying question — never presents organ names or tool lists.
router_rules.tool_selection: Each organ selects its own tools based on the mission stage. ARIF never sees tool names.
router_rules.evidence_gates: Each stage produces evidence before the next begins. If a gate fails, the pipeline stops and reports why.
router_rules.constitutional_gates: Every pipeline stage passes through F1-F13 floor check. HOLD on any violation.
router_rules.uncertainty_preservation: Uncertainty is never collapsed. Every output carries epistemic tags and confidence bounds.
router_rules.silent_healthy: Monitor missions produce zero output when all systems are healthy. Only degradation surfaces.

what_arif_never_sees: Organ names unless relevant to the decision
what_arif_always_sees: Whether any irreversible action was taken
The evidence trail (available on request, not in default output)

maturity.investigate: PARTIAL — arif_observe + organ queries exist, but not chained into silent pipeline
maturity.interpret: PARTIAL — arif_think + organ interpret tools exist, but synthesis is manual
maturity.decide: PARTIAL — arif_judge + consequence modeling exist, but not auto-chained
maturity.build: OPERATIONAL — arif_seal → A-FORGE execute chain is live with SCT enforcement
maturity.monitor: PARTIAL — health probes exist per organ, but no unified silent monitoring
maturity.remember: OPERATIONAL — L1-L6 memory with VAULT999 seal chain is live

forging_remaining.mission_router: Classify human intent → nearest mission. If ambiguous, ONE clarifying question.
forging_remaining.pipeline_executor: Chain organ calls silently. Pass evidence between stages. Stop on gate failure.
forging_remaining.output_formatter: Render mission results as ARIF-facing verdict. Never expose tools, organs, or internal state.
forging_remaining.silent_monitor: Cron-driven observation loop. Zero output when healthy. Delta-only when degraded.

tool_survival_audit.rule: Every tool must answer: which real human mission uses me?

verdicts.KEEP: Used in a tested end-to-end mission workflow
verdicts.MERGE_AS_MODE: Useful but overlaps with another tool — make it a mode parameter
verdicts.HIDE: Internal computational function — remove from public surface
verdicts.SDK_ONLY: Compatibility alias — available via SDK, not agent discovery
verdicts.REMOVE: No real workflow, no evidence of use, no mission that needs it
